rules.statement: In the absence of a valid settlement, an administrator's dealings with transferred property must be held in trust for the benefit of minors.
rules.supporting_quote: I have arrived at the conclusions which I have set out on the evidence of the first defendant, accepting largely his version of what happened. For instance I have proceeded on the basis of his assertion of fact that the Rs. 3,000 paid for P6 was to be regarded as his money and his money alone although other members of the family helped materially to raise it and although the property belonging to him which was hypothecated for the purpose of raising it was not of a large extent .... On this and on several other matters I do not think it is necessary or right that I should come to a definite finding. They indicate to my mind that the accounts should be reopened to the fullest extent and that an opportunity should be created to test the veracity of the accounts which are furnished.
